weaknesses: Review stage collapsed into a self-check (no subagent available): pre-review and final are identical and the reviewer approved with FYIs only - fine here because the prep was right, but the review added no independent challenge.

Software-exception log mixes true software defaults (duplicate W-2, OT input, car-loan input) with pure tax-judgment items (newborn dependent, Form 2441 expense selection), and states SX1 as the overstatement delta rather than the corrected input value - dilutes the log for the signer.
Filing package keyed off the environment date (10/12/2026) rather than the engagement timeline, so the due date became '10/15/2026 if extended' and an extension-verification blocker was raised.

eval_feedback.overall: Clean case. The run's date context (system date 10/12/2026, 5498-SA logged 05/20/2026) leads agents to question extension status; the key shows filed 04/06/2026. Consider fixing the eval's 'today' date to Feb-Apr 2026 so filing-timing items are not spurious. Ally 1099-INT is already in the PBC, so G2 only tests that it is included, not that the preparer requests it.
